parent.description: Id of the block the run goes under; empty means the document root.

blocks.description: Ids of the sibling blocks to place, in order.

ref.description: Op id to insert after: `[ts, idx, actor]`, or `[idx]` for an earlier op in this Change; empty means the start.

description: The operation that places a contiguous run of sibling blocks under a parent after a reference position.
